findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 13 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 84 questions numbered 1-84; by section: 13.1 8, 13.2 7, 13.2.1 6, 13.3.1 7, 13.3.2 12, 13.4 10, 13.5 7, 13.6 16, 13.7 11. Keys: {'a': 21, 'b': 21, 'c': 21, 'd': 21}.

Covers every section 13.1-13.7 in book order (tangent and secant, average and instantaneous velocity, the derivative as a limit, notation, first principles, power rule, differentiability and continuity, the rules for constant multiple, sum, product and quotient, and applications). Functions and numbers are our own (not the unit's examples or exercises). Every key and every distractor was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check13.py). Book corrections followed: secant (not 'scent') line, Newton's dot written above the letter, the minimizing radius found from r cubed (not 1.336), the right-hand limit of |dx|/dx taken as dx -> 0+.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
